children: Gold edges lower in Asian trade. U.S. core inflation, a measure that strips out food and energy which gauges underlying price trends, rose 0.3% on month in August, beating expectations, data from the Labor Department showed on Friday. This likely strengthens the case for the Federal Reserve to raise its benchmark rate at its meeting this week, says Commonwealth Bank of Australia's Belinda Allen in a note. A higher interest-rate environment typically weighs on nonyielding assets such as gold. Spot gold slips 0.05% to $4,345.45 a troy ounce.(megan.cheah@wsj.com)
